library(ggplot2)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(tictoc)
library(reticulate)
library(leaflet)

setwd("/Volumes/leca/LECA/EQUIPE-BIOM/SERVALP/EQUITES/STAGE_SAMUEL/2024_data_stage_m2_lormel/urban_recreation_model/")
results_wd = "/Users/neyretma/Documents/EquitES/UrbanES/Results_ES"

# Study area
perim_broad = vect("delimitations/perimeter_broad.shp") # Only useful for graphic representations
communes_perimeter = vect("delimitations/communes_perimeter.shp")
communes_perimeter_buff = buffer(communes_perimeter, 500)


#CoSIA Land Use, 10m resolution
colu = rast("landuse/cosia_10m.tif")
names(colu) = c("lu_num")
colu = terra::mask(colu, communes_perimeter_buff)
seg_colu = segregate(colu, classes = NULL, keep = T, other = NA) # A raster for which each layer is a landuse
# 18 Landuses, 7 and 9 are empty, 11 and 12 simply don't exist


# the urban areas, defined from the Global Human Settlement database
rast_grid = rasterize(communes_perimeter_buff, seg_colu, res = 10)
#rast_grid = resample(rast_grid, seg_colu)


# The urban areas, defined from the percentage of building cover; This is the one used in the internship work
# bA = colu
# bA = terra::mask(bA, communes_perimeter)
# bA[bA != 1] = 0
# tissu_urb <- focal(bA, w = 11, fun = sum)
# tissu_urb[tissu_urb<30.25] = NA # 25% of building cover on a 1ha sliding window


tissu_urb = rast("delimitations/GHS_2154.tif")
tissu_urb[tissu_urb<20] = NA #just a quick way to select the catergories we want, here
tissu_urb[!is.na(tissu_urb)] = 1 # Put all the values to 1
tissu_urb = as.polygons(tissu_urb, aggregate = T)

# Need to also keep the INSEE squares that are on the border
geoportail = vect("/Volumes/leca/LECA/EQUIPE-BIOM/SERVALP/EQUITES/STAGE_SAMUEL/2024_data_stage_m2_lormel/Analysis/200m_selection_urb.shp")
tissu_urb = geoportail[is.related(geoportail, tissu_urb, "intersects")]
tissu_urb_buff = buffer(tissu_urb, 1000)
city_buff = rasterize(tissu_urb_buff, rast_grid, field = "i_est_200", background = NA) # Polygonized and rasterized for a proper resolution
city_buff[!is.na(city_buff)] = 1

# Parks and green spaces, built on QGIS from OpenStreetMap
green_spaces = vect("delimitations/osm_parks.shp")

rast_parks = rasterize(green_spaces, rast_grid, field = "use_type", background = NA, fun = max)

# Selection of the parks and green areas in a buffer around urban areas. 
rast_parks = terra::mask(rast_parks, tissu_urb_buff)


# processus de patching to measure park size
buffed_parks = buffer(rast_parks, 10, background = NA) # Buffer de 10m autour de rast_parks
buffed_patches = patches(buffed_parks, 8, allowGaps = F) # Patches identifiés en Queen's case
park_patch = terra::mask(buffed_patches, rast_parks) # suppression des buffers en masquant par rast_parks

# buffed_parks = rast("delimitations/buffed_patch.tif") # Numbered patches of the parks, with a 10m buffer
# park_patch = rast("delimitations/inclu_patches_parks_10.tif") # Numbered patches with no buffer
npatches = max(values(park_patch), na.rm = TRUE) # number of parks


# Amenities
fountains = vect("amenities/osm_fountains.shp") # point layers for the fountains (they will count as watersheds)
playgrounds = vect("amenities/osm_playgrounds.shp") # children's playgrounds
fitness = vect("amenities/osm_fitness.shp") # Open air fitness areas
drink_wat = vect("amenities/osm_drinking_water.shp") # Drinking water points

am_int = list(fitness,playgrounds,drink_wat) # List of point layers or the interesting amenities

# Roads
all_roads = rast("amenities/road_noise.tif") # Raster layer of 3 "road levels", built from OpenStreetMap on QGIS

#Removing the temporary elements
rm(bA, tissu_urb, drink_wat, fitness, playgrounds)


# slu = Segregated LULC map. Each layer is a landuse. Raster map (spatRaster)
# parks = Patches of the green areas of interest, each one associated with a value. Raster map (SparRaster)
# bfp = Same as "parks", but with a 10m buffer around each patch/park. Raster map (SparRaster)
# npatches = number of parks/patches. Numeric
# 
# luH = Land-use numbers for herbacious vegetation. Vector of characters
# luT = Land-use numbers for tree-filled landuses. Vector of characters
# luW = Land-use for waterscapes. Vector of characters
# luB = land-use number corresponding to buildings. Vector of characters
# 
# ftn = Map for the fountains. Point Layer (SpatVector)
# am_int = point layer maps list for the ammenities of interest. List of  Point Layers (SpatVectors)
# 
# luna = land use numbers for the noise-abatting land uses. Vector of characters
# matw = reclassification matrix linking land-uses (those in luna) abd their weight for noise-abattment. 2-column dataframe
# 
# lvl_road = map of the roads. Roads' values are their noise level. Raster map (spatRaster)
# lvls = list of sound levels. Must be the same length as the number of categories in lvl-road. Vector of numerics


visu = visual_quality_distance(slu = seg_colu, parks = park_patch, bfp = buffed_patches,
               luH = c("13", "15"), luT = c("8", "10"), luW = c("4", "6"), ftn = fountains,
               grid = rast_grid )

terra::writeRaster(visu, paste0(results_wd, "/attractiveness2.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
visu = rast(paste0(results_wd, "/attractiveness2.tif"))


#am_int = list(crop(fitness, e),
#              crop(playgrounds, e),
#              crop(drink_wat, e))

opp = recre_opp_distance(parks = park_patch, npatches = npatches, am_int = am_int, grid = rast_grid)

terra::writeRaster(opp,  paste0(results_wd, "/opportunities2.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
opp = rast(paste0(results_wd, "/opportunities2.tif"))

gc() 

poll = pollut(parks = park_patch, slu = seg_colu, luna = c("1", "8", "10"), luB = "1",
           lvls = c(60, 80, 90), matw = data.frame(lu = c(1, 8, 10), weight = c(50,10,10)),
           lvl_road = all_roads)

terra::writeRaster(poll,  paste0(results_wd, "/pollutions2.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
poll = rast(paste0(results_wd, "/pollutions2.tif"))

all = serv_tot(attractiveness = visu, opportunities = opp, pollutions = poll)
terra::writeRaster(all,  paste0(results_wd, "/all_serv_parks.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
terra::writeRaster(all[[4]],  paste0(results_wd, "/parks_quality.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

gc()
###
e = extent( c(909858, 918949,  6455034 ,  6460157))
e = ext(890000, 940000, 6432000, 6482000)
parks_quality= rast(paste0(results_wd, "/parks_quality.tif"))
parks_quality = crop(parks_quality, e)

recre_buff_500 = best_in_buffer(parks_quality, city_buff, buff = 500)
recre_buff_500[is.na(recre_buff_500)] = 0
terra::writeRaster(recre_buff_500,  paste0(results_wd, "/recre_buff_500.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

recre_buff_300 = best_in_buffer(parks_quality, city_buff, buff = 300)
recre_buff_300[is.na(recre_buff_300)] = 0
terra::writeRaster(recre_buff_300,  paste0(results_wd, "/recre_buff_300.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

gc()

#parks_quality = extend(parks_quality, 100, fill = NA)
recre_decay = qual_decay(parks_quality, radius_in_pixels = 100, decay_half_dist = 300)
recre_decay[is.na(recre_decay)] = 0
terra::writeRaster(recre_decay,  paste0(results_wd, "/recre_decay_300.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

gc()

# Also calculate park quantity
parks_quantity = howmuch_in_buffer(parks_quality, city_buff, buff = 300)
parks_quantity[is.na(parks_quantity)] = 0
terra::writeRaster(parks_quantity,  paste0(results_wd, "/parks_quantity.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

gc()

# Distance to closest park
parks_distance = terra::distance(parks_quality)
parks_distance = terra::mask(parks_distance, city_buff)
terra::writeRaster(parks_distance,  paste0(results_wd, "/parks_distance.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
gc()

# Also total quantity of green (tree, grass)
colu_green = colu 
colu_green[! (colu_green %in% c(8, 9, 10,13, 14, 15, 16)),] = NA
colu_green[colu_green>1,] = 1
green_quantity = howmuch_in_buffer(colu_green, city_buff, buff = 300)
green_quantity[is.na(green_quantity)] = 0
terra::writeRaster(green_quantity,  paste0(results_wd, "/green_quantity.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
gc()
